title: Screen a worker before the first shift
purpose: Every wearer is 18 or older, has signed, and films on their own account.
when: Before anyone's first shift, never after. New site: launch day with the Commercial Director.

steps.check: Mano says every name is clear.

steps.do: Check the national ID. The worker photographs it themselves
steps.detail: The birth date is in the ID number. Under 18: no phone. The worker photographs both sides on their own phone and sends the photo to Ahmed Alaa.
steps.check: 18 or older, face matches, both sides readable, photo sent.

steps.do: Explain the consent form in Arabic
steps.detail: They are filmed at work, in 30-minute cycles. Private rooms are never filmed. Let them ask. On paper, or signed on a phone where the digital form is set up.

steps.do: Run the fraud briefing with the operator
steps.detail: Rules page in Arabic: the eight patterns, stop first then the hat, three flags and they are off.
steps.check: The wearer says it back. The operator signs.

steps.do: Create the account and the wearer log row
steps.detail: One person, one account. Keep the login yourself. Log name, site, start date, device number.
steps.check: Name on ID, account, and log all match.

steps.do: Hand the signed forms to Ahmed Alaa on launch day
steps.detail: Ahmed Alaa stores them, one folder per wearer. Whether we keep the ID photo, and paper or digital, is pending the lawyer.

steps.do: Give the operator the cleared names only
steps.check: Nobody films who is not on the list.

done: Everyone is cleared, file with Mano, or sits out with no phone.

fails.if: Someone looks under 18, or has no ID
fails.then: No phone goes on them. If one is already on, take it off. Tell the Portfolio Manager now.

fails.if: Someone films who never passed screening
fails.then: Tap stop, pull the phone, tell Youssef Medhat the device number and shift times. Screen everyone again.

fails.if: No signature, or they ask who it is for
fails.then: Say an AI project, nothing more. No signature, no filming. Nobody is talked into one.

fails.if: The site wants someone filming today
fails.then: Sites nominate, KMSC activates. Nobody starts before every step is done. If they keep pushing, call Moharam.

escalate: Moharam the same day when a site pushes back. Mano for the file.
